attempts.text:
**The window starts on the anchor.** Column 0, `mcbA`, is a spine column, carried by 100% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls, and the model names it in 99% of calls at 0.07 bits. Column 1 is variable, named 95%.

**Then a spine of seven columns.** Columns 2 to 8, `ybiX` to `dinG`, are carried by 90 to 93% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 0.2% of calls, named in 92 to 99.6%. The model is least sure at column 5, `ybiE`, named 92% at 0.79 bits. A fork follows at column 9, `ybiA`, named 81%.

**A second spine runs from `rhlE` to `ybhN`.** Columns 10 to 19 are carried by 93% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 0.2 to 1% of calls, named in 60 to 99%. The fewest named is column 15, `ybhR`, at 60%. Column 20 is a fork, `ybhM`, named 87%.

**The longest spine covers the `moa` and `bio` genes.** Columns 21 to 34, `ybhL` to `ybhB`, are carried by 93% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 0.2 to 7% of calls, named in 88 to 99%. Then columns 35 to 79 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 31 to 83% of calls, named in 72 to 91%. The model hesitates most at column 35, `ybhC`, named 72% at 1.86 bits. Branches there carry [[phage tail assembly]] families and [[succinate dehydrogenase]] genes, and the window ends at column 79, `sdhC`, in 26% of chromosomes.

label: mcbA
facts:
WINDOW: the mcbA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor mcbA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,924 to 3,003 from dnaA. Read in 539 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying mcbA once); 43,120 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 90% of genes, 0.49 bits on average (perplexity 1.6 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 31,272 calls, named 97%, 0.13 bits; shell 11,181 calls, named 75%, 1.31 bits; cloud 667 calls, named 7%, 3.83 bits. Outside an RGP 32,902 calls, named 96%, 0.19 bits; inside an RGP 10,218 calls, named 72%, 1.48 bits. Columns: 32 spine, 34 fork, 14 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.48 against 0.19 bits) and names fewer genes (72% against 96%); 10,218 of the 43,120 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 35 (ybhC) 1.86 bits, RGP 35%; column 36 (ybhJ) 1.65 bits, RGP 70%; column 37 (ybhI) 1.49 bits, RGP 81%. The 8 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 82%, 1.09 bits on average; the other 72 columns: named 91%, 0.43 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 35-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 31-83%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: mcbA. named 99%; 0.07 bits.
2. column 1 variable: RGP 0%. named 95%; 0.47 bits.
   1: fiu P 88%
3. columns 2-8 (7 columns) spine: share 90-93%, all P, RGP 0-0.2%. Genes: ybiX "PKHD-type hydroxylase YbiX", ybiI "C4-type zinc finger protein YbiI", ybiJ "DUF1471 family protein YbiJ", ybiE "protein YbiE", hcxB, ybiB "DNA-binding protein YbiB", dinG. named 92-99.6% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 5 (ybiE), named 92%, 0.79 bits.
4. column 9 fork: RGP 1%. named 81%; 0.96 bits.
   9: ybiA S 64% "N-glycosidase YbiA"; also espX2 S 13%
5. columns 10-19 (10 columns) spine: share 93%, all P, RGP 0.2-1%. Genes: rhlE, cecR, hlyD, ybhF "ATP-binding cassette domain-contain…", ybhS "ABC transporter permease", ybhR "ABC transporter permease", ybhQ "YbhQ family protein", ybhP "endonuclease/exonuclease/phosphatas…", clsB, ybhN "lysylphosphatidylglycerol synthase…". named 60-99% (mean 89%), fewest named at column 15 (ybhR), named 60%; most hesitant at column 19 (ybhN), 0.43 bits.
6. column 20 fork: RGP 1%. named 87%; 0.88 bits.
   20: ybhM S 75% "Bax inhibitor-1 family protein"; also "hypothetical protein" S 10%
7. columns 21-34 (14 columns) spine: share 93%, all P, RGP 0.2-7%.
